# CHILIZSKILLS

> An open-source, AI-readable developer knowledge base for building on Chiliz Chain.

ChilizSkills provides practical guidance for developers and AI coding tools working with Chiliz Chain, CHZ, Fan Tokens, Socios Wallet, DeFi, bridging, testing, indexing, and frontend development.

## Start here

- [Main skill index](https://chilizskills.xyz/SKILL.md): Read this first before writing Solidity or shipping anything on Chiliz Chain.
- [Ship](https://chilizskills.xyz/ship/SKILL.md): Move from an idea to a tested and verified Chiliz dApp.
- [Chain basics](https://chilizskills.xyz/chain-basics/SKILL.md): RPCs, chain IDs, gas, compiler targets, consensus, and testnets.

## Skills

- [Fan Tokens](https://chilizskills.xyz/fan-tokens/SKILL.md): CAP-20, decimals, migrations, addresses, staking, and wCHZ.
- [Why Chiliz](https://chilizskills.xyz/why/SKILL.md): When Chiliz Chain is a good fit and the tradeoffs to consider.
- [Security](https://chilizskills.xyz/security/SKILL.md): Chiliz-specific risks and pre-deployment checks.
- [Addresses](https://chilizskills.xyz/addresses/SKILL.md): Verified system contracts, tokens, and endpoints.
- [Tools](https://chilizskills.xyz/tools/SKILL.md): Hardhat, Remix, verification, oracles, and indexers.
- [Frontend](https://chilizskills.xyz/frontend/SKILL.md): Wallet connections, gas handling, approvals, and dApp UX.
- [LayerZero and bridging](https://chilizskills.xyz/layerzero-bridging/SKILL.md): OFT routes, endpoints, peers, and bridge safety.
- [FanX and DeFi](https://chilizskills.xyz/fanx-defi/SKILL.md): Liquidity, swaps, allowances, slippage, and pricing.
- [Indexing](https://chilizskills.xyz/indexing/SKILL.md): Events, holders, pagination, activity feeds, and reorgs.
- [Testing and QA](https://chilizskills.xyz/testing-qa/SKILL.md): Spicy testing, gas checks, address verification, and release gates.
- [Wallets](https://chilizskills.xyz/wallets/SKILL.md): Socios Wallet, Reown, network switching, approvals, and transaction UX.
